name: DSJ Keep Learning Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1989, DSJ Keep Learning 
Ltd is a Educational Services Provider in India.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company works towards two key business verticals viz, higher education and continuing education. Some of the common functions it outsources are admissions, placements, university IT and academic delivery. Company's outsourcing business is keeplearning campus platform, a fully serviced Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) that is designed to manage and run all university functions on it.
Company's keeplearning platform is focused on employment side of continuing education, where company is building programs by working top-down from corporate requirements to developing programs like Industry Readiness Program to teach relevant competencies and skills for the targeted job profile and employment testing platform to measure professionals for relevant competencies and skills.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 64.0 days to 33.6 days
cons: Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
